title: shadshiny 0.2.0
text: Eleven new components several server-side systems turn shadshiny component library full application toolkit. Data table (shad_data_table()): client-side, shadcn-styled data table multi-column sort (Shift+click), global per-column filtering, windowed pagination, single/multiple row selection persisted across pages, column visibility, sticky header, loading skeletons. Column specs via shad_col() formatters shad_fmt_number(), shad_fmt_percent(), shad_fmt_date(), shad_fmt_badge(), plus arbitrary cell render functions. input$<id> reports {selected, sort, filter, page, pageSize}; refresh server update_shad_data_table(). Dashboard shells: shad_value_box() (KPI card trend delta chip, icon sparkline slots), shad_chart_container() (card wrapper plotOutput()/htmlwidgets legend strip), shad_timeline(). Chart theming: shad_theme_ggplot2() / shad_scale_color_shad() / shad_scale_fill_shad(), shad_theme_plotly(), shad_theme_echarts4r() restyle plots active theme. shad_current_theme() reactive re-runs plot code dark-mode/preset switches. shad_chart_colors() returns categorical chart ramp hex (OKLCH converted base R – new dependency); shad_tokens() exposes full resolved token set CSS strings. Theming V2: shad_theme() builds arbitrary custom themes token overrides; shad_theme_from_registry() imports tweakcn / shadcn registry theme JSON; page_shad(theme=), shad_theme_scope(), update_shad_theme(theme=) apply page, subtree, runtime scope. Form validation: shad_validator() rules (shad_rule_required(), shad_rule_email(), shad_rule_min_chars(), shad_rule_range(), shad_rule_regex(), …), live validation, submit gating, error summary. update_shad_form_field(), shad_form_message(), shad_form_summary() provide underlying messaging. Flow / input components: shad_stepper(), shad_tree() (lazy branches via update_shad_tree(children=)), shad_rating(), shad_number_input(), shad_dropzone() (bridged Shiny’s native file upload, input$<id> standard files data frame). bound input update_*() companion. Date-range presets: shad_date_picker(mode = "range", presets = ...) adds quick-range rail; shad_date_presets() supplies default set. Streaming chat (shad_chat_ui() / shad_chat_server()): module whose handler may return complete string, chunk-yielding function, coro generator (e.g. ellmer stream); replies stream stick--bottom transcript render Markdown. shad_icon_raw(): use raw <svg> (e.g. Lucide glyph) .shad-icon sizing class. New guides: vignette("data-tables"), vignette("charts"), vignette("chat"); theming forms guides now cover custom themes shad_validator(). Two new examples: shad_run_example("07-data-explorer") shad_run_example("08-llm-chat"). input$<id>$sort data table now reports {column, direction} rather client’s terser {col, dir}. Bug fix (theme reporter): input$.shad_theme reporter read document.body Shiny.setInputValue unguarded, ran even Shiny page. Since asset bundle loads <head>, absent first pass, threw aborted rest shadshiny-shiny.js — taking shad.autoInit() . shad_current_theme() therefore never fired (charts follow runtime theme changes), components inserted renderUI() / insertUI() left un-wired, pkgdown gallery previews (Shiny) failed way. Components already page still worked, masked : runtime self-initialises DOMContentLoaded. Layout primitives: shad_container(), shad_stack(), shad_grid() / shad_grid_item(), plus page shells shad_page_sidebar() shad_page_navbar(). CSS-; spacing arguments take token step (gap = 4 var(--shad-space-4)) CSS length, shad_grid() handles responsive columns outward var() fallback chain rather utility-class grid system. Bug fix (layout): layout primitives’ custom properties inherited, shad_stack() nested inside horizontal one laid sideways (picked parent’s gap alignment). rule now resets variables initial. update_shad_sidebar(active=) selects sidebar item server, navigating elsewhere — command palette, link — moves rail . New example: shad_run_example("09-app-shell") — shad_page_sidebar() layout primitives, sparklines, ⌘K palette drives navigation, dialogs built server. Server-created overlays: shad_show_dialog() / shad_remove_dialog() build dialog, alert dialog, sheet drawer server show , way shiny::showModal() . Transient default: overlay removes closes. Native mini-charts: shad_sparkline() (line/area/bar/step) shad_mini_donut() — inline SVG painted chart tokens, follow dark mode preset switches CSS re-render. Fills shad_value_box(sparkline=). Command palette: shad_command_palette() takes items data, shad_command_trigger() opens one anywhere, update_shad_command() refreshes items server. Read selections input$<id>_event — input$<id> alone tell one selection “Settings” two. Bug fix (command dialog): shad_command(dialog = TRUE, hotkey = FALSE) rendered visible inline palette — asset infers dialog mode data-hotkey data-dialog, constructor emitted neither. Bug fix (runtime): opening command dialog destroyed . shad.portal() moves root <body>, runtime’s MutationObserver read removal unmount. move removal plus insertion, teardown now skips nodes still connected document. Scroll/focus sweep: component calls scrollIntoView() — walks every scrollable ancestor, component ordinary document flow drags whole page . Highlights now scroll container via shad.util.keepInView(), pointer-driven focus() passes preventScroll. Keyboard roving focus still scrolls, deliberately. Bug fix (command): inline shad_command() scrolled page load, every keystroke. highlight used scrollIntoView()/scrollIntoViewIfNeeded(), scroll every scrollable ancestor — harmless dialog mode, inline palette part document, page containing one opened wherever palette sat (kitchen sink, long way Tier 3 — overlays). highlight now scrolls command list . Gallery: new Data, dashboards & flow page renders V2 kit live — data table, value boxes, chart container, timeline, stepper, tree, rating, number input, dropzone, form-messaging components. Demo: kitchen-sink now covers V2 components, including plot tracks theme toolbar via shad_current_theme() live shad_validator() form. update_*() / scroll / sidebar controls moved next components drive — previously sat card foot page appeared nothing, component changed scrolled far view. Bookmarking: shad_input_otp(value=) now seeds restores code. jsonlite moves Imports (used data table theming). Bookmarking support: every stateful input now seeds initial value shiny::restoreInput(), enableBookmarking() ("url" "server") restores saved state reload. Covers shad_input(), shad_textarea(), shad_checkbox(), shad_switch(), shad_slider(), shad_toggle(), shad_toggle_group(), shad_radio_group(), shad_select(), shad_native_select(), shad_combobox(), shad_calendar(), shad_date_picker(), shad_accordion(), shad_pagination(), shad_tabs(). restored (take initial-value argument): overlays’ open state, shad_input_otp(), shad_carousel(), shad_sidebar() — values still saved, seeded back restore. Docs: Migrating base Shiny guide now complete base-Shiny→shadshiny reference — sectioned tables covering inputs, buttons, layout, navigation, overlays, notifications, outputs, typography, row tagged drop-/ restyle / keep-base, plus value-shape gotchas full update_shad_*() map. (Previously inputs-table.) Bug fix (icons): shad_icon() now carries shadshiny asset dependency, standalone icon still loads .shad-icon sizing CSS shadshiny output page (previously icons rendered size-less / invisible — e.g. icon previews pkgdown Icons article). Nested component, duplicate dependency de-duplicated . Bug fix (component init): shad.autoInit() longer throws asset bundle loads <head> document.body exists. Previously MutationObserver attached null body, aborted initialisation left dynamically inserted components (renderUI, insertUI, dynamic tabs) un-wired. Components now initialise immediately observer attaches DOM ready. Bug fix (input group): wrapped control’s width: 100% longer forces leading/trailing addons onto rows — control now flexes zero basis icons, prefixes buttons sit inline intended. icons: built-set grows 32 78, adding common glyphs — home, user, users, settings, bell, trash, pencil, download, upload, external-link, eye, eye-, lock, unlock, heart, star, bookmark, filter, refresh-cw, log-, log-, copy, clipboard, save, sun, moon, image, link, phone, map-pin, credit-card, shopping-cart, package, bar-chart, activity, zap, message-circle, send, paperclip, thumbs-, globe, github, circle-x, circle-plus, circle-help, arrow-, arrow-, chevrons--. Demo: kitchen-sink sidebar now switches main pane per nav item, chat scroller starts top “Scroll chat” round-trip visible. Documentation site. pkgdown site now full handbook. new Component gallery renders every component live — real component next exact source made — across pages display, inputs, overlays, navigation chat kit, plus live Icons reference. previews initialise client-side (dialogs, tabs carousels work) follow site’s light/dark switch. New prose guides cover Installation & setup, Forms & validation, Layout & composition, server API. New components (chat / AI kit): shad_bubble() (+ group), shad_message() (+ group, shad_message_spinner()), shad_attachment() (+ group, shad_attachment_action()), shad_marker(), shad_message_scroller() (+ item, shad_message_scroller_to_bottom() server helper) — stick--bottom streaming transcript. New components (layout & inputs): shad_native_select() (styled real <select> update_shad_native_select()), shad_empty() (empty-state panel), shad_item() (+ group, separator) — flex list-row primitive, shad_button_group() (+ text, separator) — segmented button controls, shad_input_group() (+ addon, text, button) — field shell icon/prefix/button affixes around shad_input() / shad_textarea(). New icons: file, folder, clock. Bug fix: shad_context_menu() now wraps target .shad-context-menu__zone element JS binds , right-click zone initialises instead erroring load. Demo: kitchen-sink example now exercises full variant / size / state matrix every component. Example apps: six new real-world example apps inst/examples, launchable shad_run_example(), together exercise whole component library: 01-auth-onboarding, 02-analytics-dashboard, 03-support-chat, 04-storefront, 05-settings-profile, 06-docs-reader. Bug fix: shad_toast_update() called deferred (later::later) callback now requires session passed explicitly; bundled demos , fixing “attempt apply non-function” crash toast loading→update outside reactive domain.

title: shadshiny 0.1.0
text: Initial release. framework-free port shadcn/ui design system Shiny: 49 components across three tiers, shipped single bundled htmlDependency() (npm, React, build step). Tier 1 — display & typography: button, badge, avatar (+ group), card (+ parts), alert, separator, skeleton, spinner, aspect-ratio, label, progress, breadcrumb, table (+ parts), kbd, code, shad_h1()– shad_p() typography set. Tier 2 — form inputs: input, textarea, checkbox, switch, radio group, toggle, toggle group, slider, select, combobox, input-OTP, calendar, date-picker, shad_form_field() wrapper. expose native Shiny input values via generic data-shad binding. Tier 3 — overlays: dialog, alert-dialog, sheet, drawer, popover, tooltip, hover-card, dropdown-menu, context-menu, menubar, command palette, toast. Tier 3 — navigation & structure: tabs, accordion, collapsible, pagination, scroll-area, resizable, carousel, navigation-menu, sidebar layout family. Server API: update_shad_*() helpers every valued component, shad_<overlay>_open() / _close() controllers, shad_toast() family (success/error/warning/loading, plus shad_toast_update() loading→done flows). Shiny-module safe. Theming: OKLCH --shad-* token system seven presets (slate, stone, blue, green, rose, violet, orange), page_shad(theme_preset=), runtime update_shad_theme(). Dark mode synchronizes bslib::input_dark_mode() box. Demo: shad_run_example("kitchen-sink") exercises every component, variant, server round-trip.
